Higher native contrast allows for improved resolution of details in both dark and light parts of the image, which is important if you play games with dark scenes. Native contrast not exceeding 1000:1 will be useful primarily for office purposes, up to 2000:1 will be appreciated when playing games and watching movies. Adobe RGB color gamut specifies what percentage of colors from this color space a monitor can display.
